import unittest
import money


class TestSplitAmount(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_even_split(self):
        result = money.split_amount(100, 4)
        self.assertEqual(result, [25, 25, 25, 25])
        self.assertTrue(all(type(x) is int for x in result))

    def test_uneven_split_larger_shares_first(self):
        self.assertEqual(money.split_amount(10, 3), [4, 3, 3])
        self.assertEqual(money.split_amount(11, 3), [4, 4, 3])
        self.assertEqual(money.split_amount(7, 4), [2, 2, 2, 1])

    def test_zero_total_cents(self):
        self.assertEqual(money.split_amount(0, 1), [0])
        self.assertEqual(money.split_amount(0, 3), [0, 0, 0])

    def test_single_part(self):
        self.assertEqual(money.split_amount(57, 1), [57])

    def test_total_smaller_than_parts(self):
        self.assertEqual(money.split_amount(2, 5), [1, 1, 0, 0, 0])

    def test_shares_sum_and_max_diff(self):
        result = money.split_amount(103, 7)
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 7)
        self.assertEqual(sum(result), 103)
        self.assertLessEqual(max(result) - min(result), 1)
        self.assertEqual(result, sorted(result, reverse=True))

    def test_negative_total_cents_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            money.split_amount(-1, 2)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            money.split_amount(-100, 1)

    def test_parts_less_than_one_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            money.split_amount(10, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            money.split_amount(10, -3)

    def test_bool_total_cents_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            money.split_amount(True, 2)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            money.split_amount(False, 2)

    def test_bool_parts_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            money.split_amount(10, True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            money.split_amount(10, False)

    def test_non_int_total_cents_raises(self):
        for invalid in (10.0, "10", None, [10]):
            with self.subTest(total_cents=invalid):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    money.split_amount(invalid, 2)

    def test_non_int_parts_raises(self):
        for invalid in (2.0, "2", None, [2]):
            with self.subTest(parts=invalid):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    money.split_amount(10, invalid)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
